notes: Customer: Larkspur builds real-time NPC chat + moderation and in-game query to knowledge base. Primary pain: need consistent sub-50-60ms p95 generation for 1-3 token response segments in live matches and predictable cost at scale (millions of turns/month). Interested in Dedicated or Private because of data residency and deterministic latency. Strong interest in Redwood Optimize: batching guidance, KV/prefix caching, quantization profiles (FP16 vs int8/4) and how that impacts latency/cost/quality tradeoffs. CTO quote: "We can tolerate a small uptick in latency if it saves 2-3x in ops cost, but p95 tail is non-negotiable during peak combat windows." Key technical asks: 1) end-to-end perf harness with synthetic and replayed traffic (match traces), 2) guidance on batching windows and latency SLO enforcement, 3) automated KV cache warmup strategy for popular prefixes, 4) quality regression thresholds after quantization and fallback routing to non-quant models. Security: needs SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, audit logs, and option for VPC-only control plane. Legal wants data residency region lock for EU players. Current leaning: Dedicated reserved pool for NA, Private for EU region. POC plan: 48h perf run with 3 model variants (baseline FP16, int8 quantized, hybrid attention optimized), KV caching on/off, three batching configs. Success metrics: p95 <=60ms for 95% of traffic, cost per 1k tokens reduction >=1.8x vs hosted baseline, error rate <0.2% on generation failures.
short_summary: Evaluation stage POC focused on deterministic low-latency inference for in-game chat + moderation. Very cost sensitive at scale; wants batching/caching/quantization guidance and end-to-end benchmarking.
